Note. Pairs, twin pairs with the outcome observed (cross-sectional, at Wave 1; change, at both waves); model pairs, the range of complete pairs across the focal predictors' models (Tables S5-S10). All pairs pools monozygotic (MZ), same-sex dizygotic (DZ), and opposite-sex DZ twins; no non-twin siblings are included, and DZ pairs were not modeled separately. ICC, the outcome intraclass correlation σ²u / (σ²u + σ²e) from a random-intercept model; for change, of the Wave 2 outcome conditional on Wave 1. q ≤ .05 / tested, the within-pair associations surviving Benjamini-Hochberg correction over the contrasts tested, within each outcome, pair sample, and layer; the surviving associations are listed with their βW std, by absolute size. MDE, the minimum detectable βW std at 80% power and two-sided α = .05, as a median over the contrasts tested. FDR = false discovery rate.
